Title: Authenticated user reads own profile
Preconditions: User is logged in with uid=A

Title: Authenticated user updates own profile
Preconditions: User is logged in with uid=A
Test Steps: 1) Login as uid=A; 2) Update users/A/name and users/A/phone

Title: User A updates user B profile
Preconditions: User A (uid=A) is logged in; User B exists (uid=B)

Title: Query users by email index
Preconditions: User is logged in; users data includes email fields
Test Steps: 1) Login; 2) Query users ordered/filtered by email

Title: Email key collision between two users
Preconditions: User A and User B are both valid authenticated users
Test Steps: 1) Login as A and write userEmails/x=uidA; 2) Login as B and write userEmails/x=uidB
Expected Result: Second write is allowed by current rules (log as business risk)

Title: Owner reads and updates personal task
Preconditions: Task T exists with groupId=null and createdByUserId=A; User A logged in
Test Steps: 1) Login as A; 2) Read task T; 3) Update task T

Title: User B reads user A personal task
Preconditions: Task T exists with groupId=null and createdByUserId=A; User B logged in
Test Steps: 1) Login as B; 2) Read task T

Title: Group member reads group task
Preconditions: Task T has groupId=G1; userGroups/A/G1 exists; User A logged in
Test Steps: 1) Login as A; 2) Read task T

Title: Group leader updates any group task fields
Preconditions: Task T has groupId=G1; groups/G1/leaderUserId=A; User A logged in

Title: Assignee marks task done with restricted change
Preconditions: Task T has groupId=G1; assignedToUserId=A; isDone=false; User A logged in
Test Steps: 1) Login as assignee A; 2) Update only isDone from false to true; 3) Try changing another field
Expected Result: Only isDone false->true is allowed; other field changes are denied

Title: Authenticated user updates another user group
Preconditions: User A logged in and group owned/created by user B exists
Test Steps: 1) Login as A; 2) Update group created by B
Expected Result: Write succeeds by current rules (log as authorization risk)

Title: Authenticated user adds membership for another user
Preconditions: User A logged in and target user B exists
Expected Result: Write succeeds by current rules (log as authorization risk)

Title: Authenticated user removes own membership
Preconditions: User A logged in and userGroups/A/G1 exists

Title: Query login history by time index
Preconditions: User is logged in; records contain time field
Test Steps: 1) Login; 2) Query login_history ordered/filtered by time
